meaning:
1) to twist, grasp, turn, grasp with a twisting motion
1a) (Qal) to grasp
1b) (Niphal) to twist, weave, wind

elsewhere.note: Samson took hold of the two middle pillars on which the house rested and leaned on them, the one with his right hand and the other with his left.
At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet.
The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.
